items.exampleEn: The children waited for the holiday with great anticipation.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們滿心期待地等著假期到來。

items.exampleEn: He was unwilling to lend me his car.
Don't exaggerate; the fish wasn't that big.
items.exampleZh: 別誇張了，那條魚沒那麼大。

items.exampleEn: Her speech was decisive in winning the vote.
items.exampleZh: 她的演講是贏得這次投票的關鍵。

items.exampleEn: It was a deliberate decision to live without a car.
items.exampleZh: 不買車過生活，是刻意做出的決定。
items.glossZh: 刻意的；深思熟慮的；故意的

items.exampleEn: She is a deep thinker who reads a lot of history.
items.exampleZh: 她是個讀很多歷史、想得很深的思考者。

items.exampleEn: Many visitors underestimate how cold the desert gets at night.
items.exampleZh: 很多遊客低估了沙漠晚上會有多冷。

items.exampleEn: My brother is keen on photography.

items.sentenceEn: After weeks of anticipation, the new phone sold out in hours.
items.sentenceZh: 大家期待了好幾週，新手機幾小時內就賣光了。

items.audioEn: My uncle is unwilling to drive at night because his eyes get tired.
items.audioZh: 我叔叔不願意晚上開車，因為他的眼睛會很累。
items.questionZh: 叔叔對晚上開車的態度是什麼？
options: He drives every night to work
He would rather not do it

items.sentenceEn: She has a keen eye for good design.
items.sentenceZh: 她對好的設計很有眼光。

items.sentenceEn: My friend tends to exaggerate when he tells funny stories.
items.sentenceZh: 我朋友講好笑的故事時，常常會誇大。

items.stemEn: Finding the old map was the ____ step in solving the mystery.
items.stemZh: 找到那張舊地圖，是解開謎團的關鍵一步。

items.stemEn: The mistake was not ____; he simply forgot to send the email.
items.stemZh: 那個錯誤不是故意的，他只是忘了寄那封電子郵件。

items.passageEn: There was a lot of anticipation before our basketball team chose a new captain. Most people expected Tomas, who is fast and loud, but the coach picked Mia. At first, some players were unwilling to listen to her, and they clearly underestimated her. Mia is a quiet thinker, but she is also decisive. In our first game, she made a quick change that helped us narrowly win. She told me later that it was a deliberate plan, not luck. Tomas is now keen to play better, and he admits that he used to exaggerate how good he was.
items.passageZh: 我們籃球隊選新隊長之前，大家都很期待。多數人以為會是又快又大聲的 Tomas，但教練選了 Mia。一開始，有些隊員不願意聽她的話，顯然是小看了她。Mia 是個安靜的思考者，但她也很果斷。在我們的第一場比賽中，她做了一個快速的調整，幫我們險勝。她後來告訴我，那是事先想好的計畫，不是運氣。Tomas 現在很想把球打得更好，他也承認自己以前常誇大自己的實力。

questions.questionZh: 第一場比賽為什麼能贏？
options: 隊長事先計畫好的快速調整
對手有好幾位主力球員沒來
決定離開球隊去打網球

items.promptZh: 我們低估了搬家要花的錢。
referenceEn: We underestimated how much moving house would cost.
We underestimated the cost of moving house.
rubricZh: underestimate 的用法，例如 underestimated the cost、underestimated how much 等
時態合理（例如 underestimated 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 keen 造一個句子，說說你很想做或很熱衷的一件事。
referenceEn: I'm keen to visit the mountains this summer.
My friends and I are keen to start a band.
rubricZh: keen 的用法，例如 keen to visit、keen on photography 等
時態合理（例如 am、are 等）
